open_points.subject: check_installed_instances
open_points.text: - check_installed_instances: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST take the services the installation holds a credential for, in service_id order by Unicode code point, and for each raise RefusedError naming that service at the first failure: first the credential header name equals a name in the imported KERNEL_SET_HEADER_NAMES constant compared without regard to case, host included, checked without reading the manifest; then, only when the installation selects an instance for the service, its record read by read_service_record fails any check, or the selected instance named in the record has a required header whose name equals the credential header name compared without regard to case.
open_points.other_text: - check_installed_instances: [BEHAVIOR] A service with no selected instance, or whose record lists no instance of the selected name, fails nothing here; the check reads only the given installation and the manifest, never the store, and returns None when every service passes.
open_points.question: Must a service with no selected instance still fail when its credential header is in KERNEL_SET_HEADER_NAMES, or must such a service fail nothing?
